prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1123; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sure. I'd rather keep my personal details out of it, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Conroe, Texas, near one of the main entrances. I was pulling out of a parking space when the other car came down the aisle.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving when the impact occurred?

A: I'd say I was going very slowly, maybe a walking pace. I was just backing out and had almost cleared the space.

Q: And the other vehicle, how was it moving?

A: It was coming through the lane at a steady speed. I didn't see it until it was pretty close, and then it clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any pain or discomfort right after the impact?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck started to stiffen, and by the next morning my lower back was sore too. I've been dealing with that since.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for those symptoms?

A: Yes, I saw a doctor and was diagnosed with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I'm doing physical therapy twice a week now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to get my car repaired and get back to normal. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
